ai.rationale: Advertisement Score Card is a recognizably sports-tech project — an athlete brand-value and sponsorship-intelligence platform pitched sharply at a clear audience (brand managers, agents, sponsors) with concrete outputs: social metrics, sponsorship history, brand-fit scoring, and a growth trajectory. The strongest signal is genuine AI leverage: the langchain/RAG/FastAPI stack points to real retrieval-augmented analysis rather than a bolt-on. The main weakness is completeness — only the repo URL is present, with no explainer video and no live deployed URL, which falls short of the brief's ship-it-live bar.
